responseSegmenterSpec.description: The response {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Util.Attributor.Segmentation.Spec} that we are planning to generate attributions for.

sourceSegmenterSpec.description: The source {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Util.Attributor.Segmentation.Spec} that we are planning to generate attributions for.

similarityMatcherSpec.description: The {@link Genai.Retriever.SimilaritySearchSpec} for the similarities matcher.

corroboratorSpec.description: The {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Util.Corroborator.Spec} for corroboration model and params.

attributeOnAllTags.description:
Setting this to false means using tags to limit the retrieved sources.
Setting this to true means no tags restriction on the retrieved sources.

generateRationale.description: Whether to generate rationale, which requires segmenting the sources.

credibilityLambda.description: This is a function that a user would provide to quantify credibility of a source from its attribution results.

scoreIndicatorThreshold.description:
The threshold used for determine similarity and credibility scores' indication "High", "Neutral", or "Low" for UI
default is 0.4 and 0.85.
The ranges for this threshold-indicator relationship:
    High: 0.85-1 - lower bound exclusive, higher bound inclusive
    Neutral: 0.4-0.85 - lower bound exclusive, higher bound inclusive
    Low: 0-0.4 - lower bound inclusive, higher bound inclusive
